name: Lateral Box Jump
steps: Stand sideways beside a sturdy plyometric box with feet hip-width apart and space to swing your arms.
Drop quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms back to load your hips and legs.
Drive explosively upward and sideways off both feet to land squarely on top of the box facing the same direction.
Stand tall to finish the jump, step carefully back down to the same side, and switch sides after completing one direction.
tips: Start with a lower box height than your forward box jump until lateral takeoff and landing feel effortless.
Land softly with both whole feet fully on top of the box and knees aligned over your toes.
